reason: I'm not letting an AI talk to my customers or send sales emails on my behalf because a landing page says 'GDPR-compliant'. Maybe I'd poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay 99 a month on a first look.
objection: Will it really do the work, or will it make mistakes in front of my customers and leave me with drafts I still have to check and fix? And where does my customer data go once it's connected to my CRM and mailbox?
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own data where I approve everything before it goes out, plus a reference from a Belgian or French business my size that's been using it for months without incidents and a clear DPA saying where the data is stored.
